statements.statement: The town manager said the first FY16 budget will come in below the target budget.
Free cash planned for capital in the forecast likely won't be available at that level.
No state aid increase expected; level funding or a slight reduction may be assumed.
The proposed school budget includes all recommended personnel additions for an overall increase said to be nine percent.
statements.who: a member relaying the superintendent's memo

warnings.prediction: State aid cuts from the state deficit may hit FY16.
